# Royal Wedding Hub

> Lucknow's premier luxury wedding planning and curated heritage venue concierge.

Royal Wedding Hub curates bespoke destination weddings, royal Awadhi banquets, heritage palace lawns, fine-art cinema, and comprehensive luxury wedding orchestration across Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Verified Wedding Venues (Lucknow & Outskirts)
The platform curates 32+ verified destination and heritage wedding settings with verified capacities, room inventories, and dining packages:
- Santorini Resort Lucknow (Capacity: 200–1000 guests, 42 rooms, Resort)
- Charans Club & Resort (Capacity: 300–2500 guests, 50 rooms, Resort & Banquet)
- Prayag Marriage Lawn (Capacity: 250–1200 guests, Banquet Lawn)
- Magnolia Garden Marriage Lawn (Capacity: 400–1800 guests, Heritage Lawn)
- Hotel Milenia Regency (Capacity: 150–600 guests, Luxury Hotel)
- Yash Resort (Capacity: 300–2000 guests, 50 rooms)
- Anandi Water Park Resort (Capacity: 500–3000 guests)
- Complete directory: https://www.royalweddinghub.com/venues

## Artisan Wedding Disciplines & Services
- Wedding Planning & Thematic Décor (Heritage Awadhi mandaps, royal floral design, end-to-end production)
- Photography & Cinematic Films (Fine-art bridal cinema, drone coverage, pre-wedding storytelling)
- Royal Catering & Awadhi Dastarkhwan (Authentic Nawabi galouti, dum pukht biryani, master khansamas)
- Artist & Entertainment Management (Sufi qawwali ensembles, live symphony, celebrity artists)
- Bridal & Groom Royal Styling (Trousseau curation and designer coordination)
- Bespoke Invitations & Stationery (Royal boxed wedding cards, customized wax seals)
- Complete catalog: https://www.royalweddinghub.com/services
